statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and presyncope
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is ordered
The service is supported by diagnoses Z86.73 and I49.5
The service was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits protocols indicating another payer holds primary responsibility
